decision: Compose the process-per-call qrexec invoker directly with the schema-v2 read-only policy collector behind one fail-closed Phase-1 runner.

criteria.correctness: Strongest because all five required policy scenarios flow through the same real qrexec invocation path and directly into per-scenario zero-mutation qualification evidence.
criteria.robustness: Fails before invocation when scenario wiring is incomplete and fails closed on deployment-bound Ed25519 attestation mismatch, response framing, response size, or mutation evidence drift.
criteria.latency: Adds no qrexec round trip beyond the five qualification invocations already required; composition and signature verification are local.
criteria.resourceUse: No daemon, database, WAL, background worker, or persistent cross-request process state is introduced.
criteria.regressionRisk: Low relative to alternatives because MissionQueue, WorkerRuntime, coordinator mutation semantics, and existing collector/invoker contracts are unchanged.
criteria.qa: Adds composed success, wrong-deployment-attestation, and incomplete-wiring regressions and includes them in syntax, transport, and full QA suites. Executable CI must still run green before readiness can advance.

alternatives.name: external-manual-wiring
alternatives.lesson: Leaving invoker/collector composition to deployment scripts creates a configuration gap where required deny cases or attestation bindings can be omitted.

alternatives.name: persistent-qrexec-daemon
alternatives.lesson: A daemon adds lifecycle, memory, cross-request state, and attack surface without improving the read-only Phase-1 evidence contract.

alternatives.name: state-changing-smoke-first
alternatives.lesson: Mutation before read-only policy qualification mixes routing/auth failures with MissionQueue semantics and increases blast radius.

safety: Synthetic and defensive Qubes qualification only. No financial transactions, payment data, fraud workflow, or security-control weakening.
